company: iShares Preferred and Income Securities ETF
description: iShares Preferred and Income Securities ETF tracks the ICE Exchange-Listed Preferred & Hybrid Securities Index, holding roughly 450 U.S. preferred stocks and subordinated debt instruments. Preferred shares sit between bonds and common equity in a company's capital structure: they pay fixed or floating dividends and have priority over common shareholders in liquidation, but trail bondholders. PFF yields approximately 6% or more and is heavily weighted toward the financial sector. It is sensitive to interest-rate movements and is typically used by income-seeking investors as a higher-yielding alternative to investment-grade bonds.
